reports.title: Enpro Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance Increase
section: Enpro is raising guidance for full-year 2026 and now expects revenue to be in the range of $1.33 billion to $1.34 billion, or a 16% to 17% increase year over year, adjusted EBITDA* in the range of $340 million to $345 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share* in the range of $9.70 to $9.95.

This compares to the prior guidance of revenue growth of 14%-16%, adjusted EBITDA* in the range of $330 million to $340 million and adjusted diluted earnings per share* in the range of $9.30 to $9.80 per share.
